Heart attacks occurred in 145 of 12,933 patients on fish oil (1.121%) and in 200 of 12,938 on placebo (1.546%). I took the effect as the difference in proportions, fish oil minus placebo, and used a normal-approximation 95% confidence interval.

- The difference is −0.00425.
- The standard error is 0.001426.
- The 95% confidence interval is (−0.00704, −0.00145).

The lower bound is about **−0.007**.

ANSWER: -0.007
